method: A separate Python calendar/date implementation, direct browser navigation/rendering, independent static HTML inventory, and PDF/WebP preflight artifact comparison were used after code fixes. This report is not copied from PASS1; post-deployment HTTP/browser/download checks remain open until Cloudflare publishes the commit.

checks.name: calendar algorithm cross-check
checks.independentMethod: Python datetime.date, calendar.monthrange, weekday and explicit layout rules versus Ruby-generated manifest

checks.name: route-by-route browser rendering
checks.inspection: direct local route navigation; title, H1, canonical, meaningful main text and not-found state inspected

checks.name: indexability source inventory
checks.rawResponseHttp: static source and sitemap audit; not a live HTTP claim

checks.name: PDF-to-WebP representative visual comparison
checks.remaining: No individual visual inspection of all 416 compositions.

checks.name: solar/lunar independent references
checks.solar: Node test compares NOAA calculation to independent USNO tabulated examples within two UTC minutes for matched assumptions.
checks.lunar: USNO official phase API rows are recorded with source/UTC minutes and converted via Europe/Vilnius; no lunar rise/set times are published.

checks.name: live predeployment response sample
checks.note: New 2029 route returned the expected pre-release 404 and must be retested after deployment.

checks.name: security, local privacy and accessibility spot-checks
details: release _headers includes CSP and no global noindex header
school/local planner data was exercised with malicious literal text and persisted locally
keyboard and named-control interactions exercised on representative tools
static audit checks all public image alt/dimensions, IDs, landmarks/schema and links
checks.limitation: No dedicated axe-core or formal WCAG conformance certificate.

remainingReleaseGate: After push, confirm Cloudflare production deployment success for the exact commit.
Request every new canonical URL directly and confirm actual 200, indexable HTML, single canonical, no noindex response header, sitemap membership and working CSS/JS.
Verify real PDF and WebP download responses and checksums, new 404 behavior, redirects and cache/CSP headers.
Update all 29 liveHttpStatus values in PUBLIC-PAGE-MANIFEST.json and finish this report only from observed results.
result: Independent local checks pass. The complete Pass 2 release gate is intentionally not marked finished until production deployment and live checks are observed.
